obs.title: OBS
obs.unavailable: OBS did not answer. Check the connection.

overall.sourcesMissing: {count} browser source is not loaded in OBS | {count} browser sources are not loaded in OBS
overall.sourcesFailed: {count} browser source failed on its last run | {count} browser sources failed on their last run

connection.title: Connection
connection.off: The link to OBS is switched off
connection.unreachable: Linked, but OBS did not answer
connection.loadError: The OBS connection could not load.

bridge.title: Browser source bridge
bridge.off: Off while OBS is not linked
bridge.none: No bridge page is open in OBS
bridge.optional: No bridge page is open in OBS. Only browser sources need it.

required.title: Required overlays
required.description: Add each of these to OBS once as a browser source. The bot needs them to show alerts and play sound.
required.empty: This channel has no required overlays yet.
required.loadError: The required overlays could not load.

bridge.name: OBS control
bridge.detail: Lets the bot control OBS scenes and sources from this browser source. Needed when OBS runs on another computer.
bridge.locked: Needs permission to change the OBS link

audio.name: Bot Audio
audio.detail: Plays the bot's sound clips and redemption sounds. Spoken messages play on the TTS caption source, not here.

alerts.name: Alerts
alerts.detail: Shows follows, Twitch subs, YouTube members, raids and other alerts, one at a time.

tts_caption.name: TTS caption
tts_caption.detail: Shows who is speaking and the words, and plays the spoken message. Keep Control audio via OBS on.

raid_recap.name: Raid recap
raid_recap.detail: Shows the stream recap as the closing scene of a raid.

music_player.name: Music Player
music_player.detail: Plays the YouTube song requests. Without it loaded, YouTube requests cannot play.

media_share.name: Media share
media_share.detail: Plays the clips and videos viewers share. Without it loaded, shared media cannot play on stream.

sources.title: Browser sources
sources.empty: This channel has no overlays yet.
sources.loadError: The browser sources could not load.

scenes.title: Scenes
scenes.offline: Scenes show once the OBS link is switched on.

sourceItems.title: Sources in the scene
sourceItems.offline: Sources show once OBS reports a scene on air.

connectionForm.title: OBS connection
connectionForm.description: Where the bot finds the OBS WebSocket server. In OBS: Tools, WebSocket Server Settings.
connectionForm.passwordKept: A password is stored. Leave this empty to keep it.
connectionForm.maskHelp: The last four groups send many events per second. Turn them on only when a widget needs them.

hotkeys.title: Hotkeys
hotkeys.description: Press an OBS hotkey from here, as if you pressed it in OBS.
hotkeys.otherNote: OBS does not say which source these act on, so they cannot be told apart here. Scene items OBS does not place are counted but not listed.
hotkeys.offline: Hotkeys show once the OBS link is switched on.

studio.title: Studio mode
studio.pickPreview: Pick the scene to show next

obs.needsControl: Controlling OBS needs the Editor role or the OBS control permission.
obs.needsBroadcast: Starting and stopping the stream or a recording needs the broadcast control permission.

outputs.title: Outputs
outputs.offline: Outputs show once the OBS link is switched on.

stopStream.title: Stop the stream?
stopStream.description: OBS ends the broadcast on every platform it streams to.
stopStream.viewers: Viewers see the stream end right away.
stopStream.recording: A recording keeps running; stop it separately.

audio.title: Audio mixer
audio.offline: The mixer shows once the OBS link is switched on.
audio.empty: OBS reports no inputs with audio.
audio.loadError: The audio inputs could not load.
